description:
## Goal

Delete the one-consumer generic `ContributionMap` abstraction and make activation-input updates proportional to changed contributions.

## Evidence

`ContributionMap<K,P,V>` was introduced to unify ActivationInputMap and ReturnDemandMap. ReturnDemandMap was deleted; only ActivationInputMap remains in production. Orphan `JoinContribution` implementations survive for `RuntimeDemand` and `Vec<Ty>`. On every upsert the generic path removes the slot, clones the old join, renders and sorts every publisher, rejoins every contribution, and reinserts the slot, even for an unchanged publisher value.

## Strategy and proof

1. First deduplicate identical callee contributions and resolve activation-row antichain confluence.
2. Specialize storage around `ActivationInputAlternatives` and its actual publisher/value semantics.
3. Short-circuit equal publisher updates.
4. Incrementally fold monotone ascents; retain full rebuild only for withdrawal/rebase where subtraction is required.
5. Preserve deterministic evidence order without using display text as semantic execution order.
6. Delete `ContributionMap`, `JoinContribution`, orphan RuntimeDemand/Vec implementations, generic-only tests, and collapse bookkeeping placed on `Types` solely for the generic context.
7. Prove identical activation rows, collapse events, semantic answers, causal work, and artifacts; measure contributor visits/rejoins before and after, then remove probes.
8. Run full tests, fixture matrix, determinism, formatting, and strict clippy.
title: Specialize ActivationInputMap and incrementally join true ascents
